text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BONG! BONG! BONG!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Phew. That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the first day of the new year, Daiwa Scarlet asks me to join her on a shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The start of the year is a good time to set out our goals.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course, my goal hasn't changed. I will become the number one Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The number one that she's striving for…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to be number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: When people think of the best Umamusume, I want them to picture me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's going to take more than sheer racing skill. She'll need to garner fame as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So we'll need to go where the strongest Umamusume compete…
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Arima Kinen.
Let's take on the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You can't even take part unless the fans nominate you! I can't just—
choice_data_list: You're going to be their number one, aren't you?
You're going to be their number one, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, fine. But we'll have our work cut out for us. I'll need to enter races that can qualify me for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's how we'll prove I deserve the nomination. First, we'll go for races that suit my running style, then for races with lots of competition!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, no time to dilly-dally! Let's get back to school, pronto!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Say, where do you think we should start?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You've got something in mind, right? This was your idea, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …You have got to be joking!
choice_data_list: You can't train on an empty stomach.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We don't have time to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: Let's eat before we head back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fine, we'll take a quick break, but then it's straight back to it! Got that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I grab a bite to eat with Daiwa Scarlet at one of the food stalls and we head back to the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Going back to basics on the first day of the year, huh…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Maybe a fresh start is exactly what we need.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, then there's no time to waste! How about I start with a sprint down the stairs?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet is excited to start on her new goal. Here begins our training for the new year.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's a good point. A one-size-fits-all strategy won't get us very far.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I suppose even a broken clock is right twice a day.
choice_data_list: Really piling on the praise today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. And here I was about to say you seem reliable for once.
